description: The files the string check walks past, said once for both gates and the tag test. A gate prints the rule it holds in the message a reader hits, so the reader reaches the rule without asking, and that message is a string in source — which the string check would otherwise refuse. The oxlint rule reads this through packages/devtools/src/tag-printing-gates.ts, the Python check and apps/api/tests/coding-rules-tags.test.ts read it directly, so a new gate is one edit here. The tag test pairs it against the files that still cite a tag; a file listed here that no longer prints one is a line to delete.
